HOLOSUITEVENDING.Settings.CurrencyName.H: Fallback display label and inventory item name when the game system exposes no actor currency data.
HOLOSUITEVENDING.Settings.CurrencyMode.H: Automatic uses the configured path or detects the game system's actor currency fields, then falls back to a matching inventory item.
HOLOSUITEVENDING.Settings.CurrencyPath.H: Optional dot path to a numeric value or currency object on the Actor, such as system.currency or system.wealth.value. Leave blank for automatic detection.
HOLOSUITEVENDING.Settings.CreditTransfor: Present detected system money as Credits world-wide. One Credit equals one base currency unit; deductions still use each actor's system currency.
Experimental: This is expected to work broadly, but compatibility may vary and it has not yet been tested with every game system.
